Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra and Mr. K.K. 
Harbola, Advocates, for the petitioner.
Mr. N.P. Sah, Standing Counsel, for the 
State/respondents.
The respondents, who are represented 
by the learned Standing Counsel, may file their 
counter affidavits within a period of three 
weeks from today.
List after three weeks.
Till next date of listing, any recovery,
which has been contemplated to be taken as 
against the petitioner from the family pension, 
which already stood determined, would be 
kept in abeyance.
The respondents are directed, by way 
of an interim mandamus, to continue to remit 
the pensionary benefit, as it was being paid to 
the petitioner, prior to passing of the impugned 
order dated 18.05.2021.
Interim Relief Application No. 
IA/1/2022 stands disposed of accordingly.
